title: Zesty Moroccan Lentil Tagine
description: A vibrant one-pot lentil stew brimming with Moroccan spices, a splash of Worcestershire sauce, and a bright citrus finish.
instructions: Heat the mason jar over medium heat and add the olive oil, swirling until coated.
Add the diced onion to the jar and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the sliced carrot and cook for another 2 minutes, letting the flavors mingle.
Sprinkle in the cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika, stirring to bloom the spices for 30 seconds.
Mix in the tomato paste, coating the vegetables evenly.
Pour in the lentils, ensuring they are well mixed with the spice‑vegetable base.
Add the vegetable broth, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt, then stir until all ingredients are combined.
Seal the jar with its lid and reduce the heat to low; let the mixture simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid, check the lentils for tenderness, and if needed cook for an additional 5 minutes until fully soft.
Serve hot straight from the mason jar, garnishing with optional fresh herbs if desired.
